domain: ECHELON 8 PRESENTATION AND UX / Zero-GC Subtitles (Babel), VWS

continuation13_change.problem: After the caption payload became hash-only, AudioCaptionEvents still delivered payloads through a managed IAudioCaptionEventListener object callback array. That route did not carry strings, but it left a managed listener surface in the VWS/UI caption hot path.
continuation13_change.solution: Removed IAudioCaptionEventListener, ListenerSlot, _listeners, Register(listener), Unregister(listener), and Dispatch(callback). AudioCaptionOverlay now registers as an integer-counted pull consumer only after UI and late-frame ticking are active, then drains fixed-ring payloads through ConsumeNextPendingCaption during LateFrameTick.

bounded_cursor_and_queue_proof.enqueue_index_bound: writeIndex = (head + count) % array.Length; count is accepted only while pending + next < 32, so writeIndex is always 0..31.
bounded_cursor_and_queue_proof.consume_index_bound: ConsumeNextPendingCaption reads _pendingEvents[_pendingEventHead] only when _pendingEventCount > 0; head advances by modulo _pendingEvents.Length.
bounded_cursor_and_queue_proof.drop_bound: DropQueuedCaptionPayloads first returns if both counts are zero; otherwise Array.Clear touches the two fixed 32-entry rings and resets heads/counts.
bounded_cursor_and_queue_proof.caption_text_bound: TryWriteCaptionText writes into caller Span<char>; fallback displayLength=min(fallback.Length,destination.Length), loop writes only i < displayLength, and ellipsis requires displayLength >= 3.
bounded_cursor_and_queue_proof.known_utf8_writer_bound: LocRegistry.TryWriteKnownLocalizedSpanFromUtf8 delegates to DecodeUtf8VisualSpan with the already-resolved ReadOnlySpan<byte>; DecodeUtf8VisualSpan bounds charCursor by maxGlyphs=min(destination.Length, MaxDecodedGlyphs).

cinematic_and_scalability.cinematic_cheat: No physical simulation was added. The fix is a cheap visual-delivery route: hash payload -> fixed ring -> overlay pull -> caller-owned char buffer -> TMP SetCharArray.
cinematic_and_scalability.continuous_scalability: No binary isLowEnd/LowEnd branch was added. Existing GlobalQualityWeight routes remain the quality control: BabelSubtitleSyncRuntime.ResolveCanvasDirtyBudget at line 700, LocRegistry.ResolveGlobalQualityWeight at line 2821, BabelRichTextLodPolicy.ShouldStrip/ShouldEnableTmpRichTextParsing at lines 14 and 21.
